description: Regular bail file karni hai Sessions Court Patna mein. My client Arvind Prasad s/o Shyam Sundar Prasad, age 42, R/o Kankarbagh, Patna. FIR No. 412/2026, PS Gandhi Maidan, sections BNS 318(4), BNS 316(2), BNS 318(4). He was arrested on 20 Sep 2026 and tab se judicial custody mein hai. Complainant ka allegation hai ki usne Rs 6,50,000 diye the and the applicant cheated him. Facts: the money was paid under a land-sale agreement of 2 Mar 2025; the sale did not go through because the land was under a family partition suit, and he has offered to return the money. Grounds: (1) the dispute is purely civil, it arises from the failed land-sale agreement of 2 Mar 2025; (2) he is falsely implicated to pressurise him in the civil dispute; (3) the charge sheet has been filed, so his custody is no longer needed for investigation. He has never been accused of any offence before. His elderly mother aged 72 depends on him. No earlier bail application has been filed.
